title: Execution Orchestration
purpose: Defines the generic execution orchestration component that sequences stage execution according to an execution profile without prescribing concrete workflows.

normative_requirements.text: The execution orchestrator component shall accept a sequence of stages and an execution profile, execute each stage in order, enforce declared preconditions for each stage, and halt execution when any stage fails or produces an unrecoverable error.

The execution orchestrator component shall respect the execution profile's declared safety gates: orchestration shall not skip declared required stages, bypass preconditions, or silently continue past a failure without explicit authority.
